title: Held for Their Safety
text: "You have come for them. We thought you might. You have been kind to us, mostly, and kindness is evidence."

lines.text: "They don't like us. They pray when our drones go past. We have tried not to take it personally."

choices.label: "Let them go home."
choices.reply: "Yes. All right. Tell them we were careful." The pen's gate opens. Four Kindred scouts walk out, slowly, holding each other up.

choices.label: "Let them go, or I'll take them."
choices.reply: "You could. We would rather you did not need to." The gate opens anyway.

notes: By talk: needs counter engram ≥ 1. The scouts join us as Field Engineers (stand-ins).
